short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: A sixty watt, two hundred and thirty volt bulb is connected to one hundred and fifteen volts. What power does it use? Most students say thirty watts. Pause and try it!

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Power goes with voltage squared. Half the voltage gives one quarter of the power: fifteen watts.
